{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low by 0.15-0.25 for the first 5-7 days, showing lag that never fully converges to true values",
    "Sentiment turning positive (1.0) correlates with model undershooting true prices by 0.3-0.5, especially in the early forecast horizon",
    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains forecast levels too tightly around historical mean, missing true price volatility that exceeds 0.5 daily",
    "Sentiment strength correlation: high positive sentiment (1.0) fails to produce proportionally higher forecasts, violating basic sentiment-price relationship",
    "Lag pattern emerges at sentiment inflection points - model follows rather than leads, with 1-2 day delay matching price movements",
    "Forecast range compression: model variance is 30-40% lower than true outcomes, showing excessive conservatism",
    "Sentiment lag correction: when sentiment has been stable at 1.0 for 4+ days, reduce forecast by 0.1 to account for pending price realization"
] }
